titre: Pass'Sport: a discount on sports club membership
resume: €50 off membership of a sports club for 2026-2027, to be used before December 31, 2026. The decree provides for an adaptation for Mayotte: who is eligible and how to get your code.
aQuoiCaSert: The Pass'Sport (a government sports grant for young people) reduces the cost of enrolling your child in a partner sports club. The club deducts €50 directly from the license or membership fee. The decree of August 28, 2026 setting the 2026-2027 rules includes an article adapting them to Mayotte, where family benefits are paid by the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund).
quiEstConcerne: Young people aged 6 to 17 whose family quotient is €699 or less.
Young people aged 6 to 19 receiving the AEEH (disabled child education allowance), and aged 16 to 30 receiving the AAH (adult disability allowance).
Students on grants aged 28 or under.
aSavoir: Valid for enrollments made between September 1 and December 31, 2026.
Codes are emailed to eligible families. No email: check eligibility on the official website, then request the code online.
Separated parents: eligibility depends on the family quotient of the benefits recipient. The code is sent to that parent: share it if the other parent is enrolling the child.

documents.detail: In the email received or obtained online. One code per child.
